templates.title: MongoDB Dump Scheduler (Edge)
templates.description: Scheduled, encrypted mongodump backups shipped to S3-compatible storage, with retention, restore verification and optional central management via a Portal.
templates.note: The web UI listens on the mapped host port (default 9999) once the container is healthy; check /health. The LiteDB config, AES key and backup files persist in a single named volume. All Portal, S3/MinIO and notification variables are optional — leave them blank to run this Edge standalone.

env.name: MDBDR_TAG
env.label: Image tag
env.description: macoev/mdbdr tag to deploy, e.g. master or a version tag.

env.name: MDBDR_PORT
env.label: Host port
env.description: Host port published for the Edge web UI.

env.name: PORTAL_BASE_URL
env.label: Portal base URL
env.description: Optional. URL of a MongoDumpScheduler Portal to register this Edge with, e.g. https://portal.mydomain.com.

env.name: PORTAL_API_KEY
env.label: Portal API key
env.description: Optional. API key issued by the Portal after registering this Edge.

env.name: PORTAL_EDGE_NAME
env.label: Portal edge name
env.description: Optional. Friendly name for this Edge shown in the Portal.

env.name: PORTAL_AUTHORITY
env.label: Portal OIDC authority
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: PORTAL_CLIENT_ID
env.label: Portal OIDC client ID
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: PORTAL_CLIENT_SECRET
env.label: Portal OIDC client secret
env.description: Optional. Needed only for Portal machine-to-machine authentication.

env.name: MINIO_ENDPOINT
env.label: S3/MinIO endpoint
env.description: Optional. S3-compatible endpoint backups are uploaded to.

env.name: NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED
env.label: Enable webhook notifications
env.description: Optional. true or false — notifies only on failures, never on success.
